caption: The drawing depicts a small model building resembling a bank, labeled "NOVELTY BANK" above the front door. The main body of the building is blue, with a red roof featuring a chimney and a rectangular coin slot. The front face has architectural details such as arched windows and a double-door entrance painted in blue, with both the windows and doors bordered by a grey color. The roof has pronounced angles and raised roof sections, with worn and chipped paint indicating use or age. The building sits on a red rectangular base. On the upper right corner of the drawing, there is a small, separate black line illustration showing a figure standing on a similar base, operating a lever next to a railing, facing a coin on the ground. The background is plain and light-colored, enhancing the focus on the central object and the inset illustration.
title: Toy Bank
